svg.title: The near-equation vector is an explicit linear combination of transported degree-five insertions. Its weighted sensor estimate is stronger than bare convergence to the equation subspace. The proof therefore constructs a funded local marker with a genuine finite density variation and replicated root bound. A formal integration by parts symbol, without its local representative and expense estimates, would not supply this weighted conclusion. The near-kernel vector required in (TR50) is a specific combination of two transported degree- five insertions.
